product_family: AutoDraw – a free, web-based drawing tool powered by machine learning that recognizes sketches and suggests refined vector versions. Created by Google Creative Lab as an AI experiment, operates in-browser without login.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of SOC 2 certification specific to Autodraw. Autodraw is a free consumer experiment, not an enterprise offering with compliance certifications.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification for Autodraw. Autodraw is a free consumer tool without enterprise-grade security certifications.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliant
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a GDPR compliance claim or certification specific to Autodraw. Google's general Privacy Policy references EU/UK data protection law ('If European Union (EU) or United Kingdom (UK) data protection law applies to the processing of your information...'), but neither autodraw.com nor the Autodraw experiment page states GDPR compliance for this product, and GDPR is a legal regime rather than a certification a product 'holds'.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No evidence of HIPAA compliance. Autodraw is a free consumer drawing tool, not designed for healthcare or protected health information.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Not applicable. Autodraw is a free tool with no payment processing or credit card handling.

privacy.ai_training_note: Google's updated privacy policy (as of 2024) allows use of publicly available data to train AI models. Autodraw sketches may be used for Google's AI training, but no explicit opt-out mechanism exists for Autodraw specifically. Status unclear.
privacy.data_region: Not specified; likely processed globally via Google infrastructure

security.name: Login required
security.value: No login required; runs in browser as anonymous user

products.name: Autodraw Web App
products.data_scope: User sketches and drawing strokes; no persistent user accounts
products.notes: Free, browser-based. No account creation required. Uses ML to recognize sketches and suggest improvements. Works on desktop, tablet, mobile.

flags: Thin compliance surface: Autodraw has no dedicated trust center, privacy page, or security documentation. Relies entirely on Google's standard policies.
Data training opacity: Google's updated privacy policy allows public data use for AI training, but no explicit statement on whether Autodraw sketches are included. No opt-out available.
Over-claim risk: Some third-party review sites (e.g., 10web.io) imply Autodraw has robust privacy/security features, but the vendor's own site provides no such detail.
No DPA: As a free consumer tool, Autodraw does not offer Data Processing Agreements, making it unsuitable for business or regulated-industry use.
Consumer-only: Explicitly positioned as a free, simple drawing experiment. No enterprise features, no SLA, no support contract. Expect minimal backwards-compatibility guarantees.
